d: After Indira Gandhi and her associates lost the elections following 1975, the Janata Party formed the government; during this period, Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi—who were still in school—had to face discrimination. This is an account shared by Rahul and Priyanka themselves. In a conversation with her mother, Sonia Gandhi, Priyanka recounted how a child once said to her, "Your uncle is a thief," and mentioned that no child in class would sit near Rahul Gandhi. To keep things normal, only one child attended Rahul’s birthday party—an arrangement made by his grandmother, Indira.
